scope: All eight ordering families are known at design time. Zero new independent validations.
baseline: Frozen zero-external-heat construction, including all originally marked roof and whole ground actions.
sources: Realize each frozen ordering once under that baseline; keep the actual identity, whole original physical footprint, 25m2, fuel mass, and energy through the final plan. No redraw or source substitution after baseline.
initial_compartments: Collect all physical parts bearing any of the eight actual ordinary roof labels. Partition those parts into connected components under the radius-plus-tolerance polygon support graph. For each family include precisely the components intersecting the fixed original footprint.
threshold: Use the smallest common published ceilings covering the construction-independent initial compartments’ full outward-rounded area and original owner-count upper bounds. Also test the preexisting 241.49 m2 and 3 benchmark, without requiring it.
construction: All external direct contacts and full-lifetime dry-energy escape inequalities, whole ordinary roof owners under the physical AND, whole ground cells, minimum action union within fixed baseline and compartments.
expenses: Only a deterministic geometric/energy evaluation and GIS. No native fire simulation.
